sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS ACROSS THE N CENTRAL U.S
sections.text: ...THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS ACROSS THE ERN SEABOARD FROM SRN NEW ENGLAND TO SC...

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: A POTENT MID-LEVEL SHORT-WAVE TROUGH IS FORECAST TO CONTINUE DIGGING QUICKLY ESEWD ACROSS THE CANADIAN PRAIRIE AND ADJACENT N CENTRAL U.S. THIS PERIOD. MEANWHILE FARTHER E...A WEAKER TROUGH IS FORECAST TO CROSS THE APPALACHIANS EARLY...CONTINUING EWD AND MOVING OFFSHORE LATE. AT THE SURFACE...A STRONG COLD FRONT -- ASSOCIATED WITH THE N CENTRAL U.S. UPPER SYSTEM -- IS FORECAST TO MOVE QUICKLY SEWD ACROSS THE NRN PLAINS THROUGH THE DAY...AND IS EXPECTED TO EXTEND FROM THE UPPER GREAT LAKES REGION SWWD INTO WRN OK/W TX BY THE END OF THE PERIOD. IN THE EAST...A COLD FRONT IN LEE OF THE APPALACHIANS IS PROGGED TO SHIFT SLOWLY EWD THROUGH THE DAY...REMAINING ONSHORE THROUGH THE AFTERNOON BUT BEGINNING OFFSHORE PROGRESS BY EVENING. BOTH OF THESE FRONTS WILL FOCUS CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT -- AND SOME SEVERE POTENTIAL -- THIS PERIOD.

sections.title: N CENTRAL CONUS
sections.text: COOLING ALOFT ATOP A MOISTENING BOUNDARY LAYER WILL LEAD TO MODERATE DESTABILIZATION AHEAD OF THE FAST-MOVING COLD FRONT THIS AFTERNOON. AS A RESULT...EXPECT FOCUSED ASCENT ALONG THE FRONT TO DRIVE STORM INITIATION IN THE NWRN MN/SERN ND REGION DURING THE MID-AFTERNOON HOURS...WITH AT LEAST SCATTERED DEVELOPMENT OCCURRING SWWD ALONG THE FRONT THEREAFTER -- POSSIBLY AS FAR SW AS NEB. THE GREATEST SEVERE POTENTIAL HOWEVER -- LIKELY IN THE FORM OF DAMAGING WINDS ASSOCIATED WITH A WELL-ORGANIZED LINE AND POSSIBLY SOME BOWING STRUCTURES -- IS EXPECTED ACROSS A PORTION OF THE ERN DAKOTAS BUT PARTICULARLY MN...FROM FROM MID AFTERNOON THROUGH EARLY EVENING. SOME THREAT MAY CONTINUE EWD INTO WRN PORTIONS OF THE UPPER GREAT LAKES REGION LATER IN THE EVENING...BUT DIURNAL COOLING/STABILIZATION SUGGEST LESSER POTENTIAL THAN EARLIER/FARTHER W. FARTHER SW INTO IA/NEB -- AND POSSIBLY NRN KS/NRN MO AFTER DARK...A MORE MULTICELL-TYPE EVENT IS EXPECTED WITH ISOLATED POTENTIAL FOR MARGINAL WIND/HAIL.

sections.title: E COAST FROM SRN NEW ENGLAND TO SC
sections.text: STORM DEVELOPMENT IS FORECAST BY EARLY AFTERNOON E OF THE APPALACHIANS...WITHIN A MOIST/DESTABILIZING AIRMASS NEAR AND AHEAD OF THE SLOWLY ADVANCING COLD FRONT. GIVEN DEGREE OF DESTABILIZATION CURRENTLY ANTICIPATED...SHEAR -- WHILE SOMEWHAT MODEST IN MOST AREAS -- WILL BE SUFFICIENT TO SUPPORT MULTICELLS/WEAK SUPERCELLS AND ATTENDANT POTENTIAL FOR LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS AND/OR HAIL. WHILE A FEW STRONGER STORM CLUSTERS COULD SUPPORT LOCALLY GREATER SEVERE WEATHER COVERAGE...CONFIDENCE IS NOT HIGH ENOUGH ON WHERE THESE GREATER THREAT CORRIDORS MAY EXIST -- THUS PRECLUDING INTRODUCTION OF HIGHER PROBABILITIES WITHIN THE SLIGHT RISK AREA. THE THREAT SHOULD CONTINUE INTO THE EVENING AS STORMS MOVE ACROSS COASTAL REGIONS...BEFORE GRADUALLY SHIFTING OFFSHORE THROUGH LATE EVENING. ..GOSS/HURLBUT.. 08/15/2012

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: A SERIES OF PROGRESSIVE SHORT WAVE TROUGHS ACROSS THE CENTRAL AND ERN CONUS IS EXPECTED TO PROVIDE DYNAMIC SUPPORT FOR MORE INTENSE THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT TODAY AND TONIGHT. A STRONG SHORT WAVE TROUGH DROPPING SEWD ACROSS SRN PARTS OF SASKATCHEWAN/ALBERTA AND NRN MT IS FORECAST TO MOVE ACROSS THE NRN PLAINS BY EVENING REACHING THE UPPER MS VALLEY LATE TONIGHT. DOWNSTREAM FROM THIS SYSTEM...SEVERAL WAVE TROUGHS /ONE OVER THE GREAT LAKES...A SECOND OVER THE UPPER OH VALLEY/CENTRAL APPALACHIANS...AND A THIRD ACROSS NEW ENGLAND/ WILL CONTINUE EWD THROUGH TONIGHT. AT THE SURFACE...A STRONG COLD FRONT CURRENTLY FROM CENTRAL ND INTO NRN WY WILL MOVE EWD/SEWD TO A NRN MN/SERN SD/SWRN NEB/NRN CO LINE THIS EVENING...REACHING WRN LAKE SUPERIOR/UPPER MI/CENTRAL IA/CENTRAL KS AND NRN NM BY THE END OF THE PERIOD. IN THE ERN STATES...A WEAKER COLD FRONT WILL MOVE SLOWLY EWD ACROSS PARTS OF NEW ENGLAND...THE MID ATLANTIC COAST AND THE ERN CAROLINAS TODAY...WHILE THE WWD TRAILING PORTION OF THE FRONT EXTENDS ACROSS THE LOWER MS VALLEY INTO NRN TX.

sections.title: UPPER MS VALLEY INTO THE MIDDLE MO VALLEY
sections.text: STRENGTHENING SLY LOW LEVEL WINDS AHEAD OF THE ADVANCING COLD FRONT TODAY WILL RESULT IN MOISTURE INCREASING NWD FROM THE MIDDLE MO VALLEY INTO NRN MN...WITH SURFACE DEW POINTS IN THE LOW-MID 60S EXPECTED THIS AFTERNOON. THE MOISTURE AXIS WILL COINCIDE WITH THE ERN EDGE OF STEEPER MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES...AND WHEN COUPLED WITH DIABATIC HEATING THE ENVIRONMENT WILL DESTABILIZE SUBSTANTIALLY WITH MLCAPE REACHING 1000-2000 J/KG DURING THE AFTERNOON. CURRENT BANDS OF ELEVATED CONVECTION OVER SRN MN ARE EXPECTED TO CONTINUE EWD AND GRADUALLY DISSIPATE LATER THIS MORNING. PRIMARY CONVECTION IS EXPECTED TO DEVELOP ALONG THE COLD FRONT DURING THE MID/LATE AFTERNOON...FIRST OVER PARTS OF NWRN MN INTO EXTREME SERN ND/WEST CENTRAL MN...THEN SWWD ALONG THE FRONT ACROSS SERN SD INTO CENTRAL NEB. ALTHOUGH THE STRONGEST WESTERLY MID LEVEL WINDS WILL REMAIN WEST OF THE COLD FRONT...FLOW ALOFT WILL GRADUALLY INCREASE OVER THE WARM SECTOR WITH SUFFICIENT VERTICAL SHEAR /30-40 KT IN THE LOWEST 6 KM/ TO SUPPORT LINE SEGMENTS AND A FEW SUPERCELL STORMS. THE INITIAL STORMS WILL BE CAPABLE OF PRODUCING DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND VERY LARGE HAIL. THERE ARE INDICATIONS FROM MODEL GUIDANCE INCLUDING CONVECTION-

sections.title: NEW ENGLAND INTO THE ERN CAROLINAS
sections.text: ONGOING STORMS FROM ERN MA INTO ERN LONG ISLAND ARE ASSOCIATED WITH A LEAD SHORT WAVE TROUGH. THIS ACTIVITY IS EXPECTED TO PROGRESS EWD/NEWD THIS MORNING. REFLECTIVITY CORES HAVE BEEN SLOWLY WEAKENING AND THIS TREND IS EXPECTED TO CONTINUE FOR THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS. VISIBLE IMAGERY SHOWS FEWER CLOUDS FROM SERN NY/SWRN NEW ENGLAND INTO THE ERN CAROLINAS AND THIS IS WHERE STRONGER DIABATIC HEATING AND DESTABILIZATION IS LIKELY TO OCCUR. GIVEN SURFACE DEW POINTS IN THE UPPER 60S-LOWER 70S...THE AIR MASS WILL BECOME MODERATELY UNSTABLE WITH MLCAPE REACHING 1500-2000 J/KG. ADDITIONAL STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP BY LATE MORNING/EARLY AFTERNOON FROM THE MIDDLE ATLANTIC COASTAL SECTIONS SWD INTO ERN PARTS OF THE CAROLINAS AS LARGE SCALE FORCING FOR ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH THE APPROACHING SHORT WAVE TROUGHS OVERSPREADS THE REGION...WITH POTENTIAL FOR STRONGER CELLS TO PRODUCE DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND LARGE HAIL. A SOMEWHAT GREATER SEVERE THREAT MAY EXIST FROM THE DELMARVA PENINSULA SWD INTO ERN NC. STRONGER WINDS ALOFT ARE EVIDENT IN REGIONAL RAOBS AND VAD WIND PROFILES OVER THE TN VALLEY/CENTRAL APPALACHIANS IN ASSOCIATION WITH THE SHORT WAVE TROUGH/VORTICITY MAX MOVING ACROSS THIS AREA.

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: A MORE DYNAMIC FLOW REGIME APPEARS TO BE EVOLVING ACROSS PORTIONS OF THE NRN PLAINS TO UPPER MIDWEST AS WELL AS PARTS OF THE EAST THROUGH TODAY. NUMEROUS PROGRESSIVE SHORTWAVE TROUGHS ARE EXPECTED TO PROVIDE DYNAMIC SUPPORT FOR MORE INTENSE TSTMS THROUGH TONIGHT OVER SOME OF THESE AREAS. ONE STRONG SHORTWAVE TROUGH WAS DIGGING SEWD OVER NRN MT AND IS FORECAST TO SPREAD RAPIDLY EAST ACROSS THE NRN PLAINS BY EVENING REACHING THE UPPER MS VALLEY LATE TONIGHT. DOWNSTREAM FROM THIS TROUGH...SEVERAL MID/UPPER LEVEL DISTURBANCES ARE ROTATING THROUGH THE MEAN LARGER SCALE TROUGH ANCHORED OVER THE ERN U.S. /ONE OVER THE GREAT LAKES...A SECOND NOW CROSSING THE CENTRAL APPALACHIANS...AND A THIRD OVER NEW ENGLAND/. AT THE SFC...A STRONG COLD FRONT CURRENTLY FROM CNTRL ND SWWD INTO WY WILL CONTINUE SPREADING EWD/SEWD TO A NRN MN-SERN SD-SWRN-NEB-NRN CO LINE BY THIS EVENING. THE FRONT SHOULD STRETCH FROM THE UPPER PENINSULA OF MI ACROSS MOST OF WI AND NRN IL AND INTO CNTRL/SWRN KS BY THU MORNING. IN THE EAST...WHILE ONE WEAK COLD FRONT/WIND SHIFT HAS ALREADY PASSED OFF THE ERN SEABOARD...THE WEAK TRAILING AND FRAGMENTED PORTIONS OF THIS BOUNDARY EXTEND INLAND/SWWD AND WWD ACROSS THE DEEP SOUTH/N

sections.title: UPPER MS VALLEY INTO THE MIDDLE MO VALLEY
sections.text: WHILE SOME MINOR ADJUSTMENTS HAVE BEEN MADE TO THE SLGT RISK IN THESE AREAS...FORECAST REASONING IS ESSENTIALLY UNCHANGED FROM EARLY MORNING OTLK UPDATE. STRENGTHENING SLY LOW LEVEL WINDS AHEAD OF THE ADVANCING FRONT WILL RESULT IN INTENSIFICATION OF NWD MOISTURE TRANSPORT FROM THE MID MO VALLEY TO NRN MN. SFC DEWPOINTS SHOULD RISE TO THE LOW-MID 60S THIS AFTERNOON AND THE MOIST AXIS WILL COINCIDE WITH THE ERN EDGE OF STEEPER MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES. WHEN COUPLED WITH SFC HEATING....MLCAPE OF 1000-2000 J/KG SEEMS QUITE ATTAINABLE AMIDST WEAKENING CONVECTIVE INHIBITION. ELEVATED CONVECTION AND CLOUD DEBRIS ACROSS IA AND SRN MN SHOULD SPREAD EAST AND GRADUALLY DISSIPATE LATER THIS MORNING WITH PRIMARY TSTM DEVELOPMENT OCCURRING ALONG THE COLD FRONT DURING MID/LATE AFTERNOON OVER PARTS OF ERN ND...NWRN MN AND WCNTRL MN. AS FORCING ALONG THE FRONT CONTINUES TO SPREAD INTO MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIRMASS...STORMS SHOULD INITIATE SWWD ALONG THE FRONT INTO SERN SD AND CNTRL NEB BY EVENING. MORE ISOLATED DEVELOPMENT ALSO APPEARS POSSIBLE AS FAR SW AS NERN CO AND NWRN KS. WHILE STRONGEST MID LEVEL WINDS AND SHEAR APPEAR TO REMAIN ON THE COOLER SIDE OF THE FRONT...FLOW ALOFT IS FORECAST TO STRENGT

sections.title: EAST COAST
sections.text: AREAS OF STRONGER SFC HEATING OVER SRN NEW ENGLAND...SERN VA AND THE ERN CAROLINAS WILL CONTRIBUTE TO MODERATE TO LOCALLY STRONG DESTABILIZATION THROUGH THE AFTERNOON. WEAK HEIGHT FALLS/DCVA WITH A TROUGH NOW CROSSING THE CNTRL APPALACHIANS SHOULD AID IN SCATTERED TSTM DEVELOPMENT WHILE MODEST MID LEVEL FLOW ASSOCIATED WITH THE ADVANCING TROUGH RESULTS IN SUFFICIENT SHEAR FOR ORGANIZED STORMS IN THE FORM OF LINE SEGMENTS AND PERHAPS A SUPERCELL OR TWO. TIMING OF THE STRONGER FORCING AND SHEAR COINCIDENT WITH GREATEST DIURNAL DESTABILIZATION APPEARS TO FAVOR THE VA TIDEWATER AND ERN CAROLINAS FOR A ROUND OF STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS LATER THIS AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING WITH SOME HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS BEING THE GREATEST THREATS. A BRIEF/ISOLATED TORNADO CANNOT BE RULED OUT BUT THE OVERALL PROBABILITY APPEARS LOW.

sections.title: NRN NEW ENGLAND
sections.text: SUBSIDENCE IN THE WAKE OF A DEPARTING SHORTWAVE TROUGH WILL ALLOW PARTS OF INTERIOR NEW ENGLAND TO WARM UP AND DESTABILIZE AHEAD OF THE NEXT DISTURBANCE MOVING EAST FROM LOWER MI. STRONGER DYNAMIC FORCING APPEARS TO ARRIVE JUST BEYOND THE DIURNAL HEATING CYCLE AND SHEAR OVER THE REGION IS ALSO FORECAST TO REMAIN SOMEWHAT MARGINAL FOR MORE ORGANIZED/PERSISTENT STORMS. NONETHELESS...A COUPLE OF STRONGER STORMS WITH HAIL AND LOCALLY STRONG WINDS ARE A POSSIBILITY FROM ERN VT ACROSS ME INTO THE EVENING.

sections.title: NRN TX TO NRN GULF COAST
sections.text: RELATIVELY STRONGER WLY MID LEVEL FLOW FROM THE SRN PLAINS TO THE SOUTHEAST WILL RESIDE ATOP FRAGMENTED/RESIDUAL FRONTS AND OUTFLOWS ACROSS THESE AREAS. IN ADDITION...WEAK PERTURBATIONS WITHIN THIS FLOW WILL AID LIFT ALONG THE BOUNDARIES AND GULF BREEZE CIRCULATIONS MAY ALSO ENHANCE TSTM PROSPECTS IN A VERY MOIST AND INCREASINGLY UNSTABLE AIRMASS. GIVEN THESE CONDITIONS IT SEEMS REASONABLE TO EXPECT A SCATTERING OF MORE INTENSE AND LONGER-LIVED MULTICELL STORMS THROUGH THE LATE AFTERNOON WITH SOME CHANCE FOR HAIL TO ABOUT AN INCH AND LOCALLY DAMAGING WET MICROBURSTS.

sections.title: SRN AZ
sections.text: MOISTURE EVIDENT ON TUS MORNING SOUNDING WILL LIKELY FUEL TSTM DEVELOPMENT AS HEATING ACROSS THE HIGHER TERRAIN INTENSIFIES LATER TODAY. ELY COMPONENT OF MID LEVEL 20-25KT WINDS WILL AID IN BOTH STEERING CONVECTION OFF THE HIGHER TERRAIN AND SHEARING UPDRAFTS SUFFICIENTLY FOR PERSISTENCE AND ADDITIONAL UPSCALE DEVELOPMENT. ONE OR TWO STORMS CLUSTERS MAY EVOLVE FROM THIS PROCESS AND SPREAD WWD INTO HOTTER LOWER ELEVATIONS WITH THE PROSPECTS FOR AT LEAST ISOLATED DAMAGING WINDS AND BLOWING DUST INCREASING THROUGH THE EVENING. SITUATION WILL BE REVIEWED AGAIN AT 20Z AND GREATER SEVERE PROBABILITIES MAY BE INTRODUCED AT THAT TIME. ..CARBIN/LEITMAN.. 08/15/2012

sections.title: UPPER MIDWEST/UPPER MS VALLEY
sections.text: FORECAST REMAINS ON TRACK FOR THE SLIGHT RISK ACROSS THIS REGION. WATER VAPOR IMAGERY SHOWED THE PROGRESSIVE SHORTWAVE TROUGH MOVING ESEWD THROUGH SOUTH CENTRAL CANADA AND WRN ND AS OF 1930Z. WSWLY MIDLEVEL WINDS ARE STRENGTHENING ACROSS THE DAKOTAS WITH SPEEDS OF 60-65 KT IN ND PER WSR-88D VADS. OBJECTIVE ANALYSES INDICATED A SUBSEQUENT INCREASE IN EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR E/SEWD AHEAD OF THE TROUGH INTO THE UPPER MIDWEST/UPPER MS VALLEY. FOR ADDITIONAL SHORT TERM CONVECTIVE DETAILS...REFER TO SPC MESOSCALE DISCUSSION 1766.

sections.title: ERN CAROLINAS TO MID ATLANTIC STATES AND SRN NEW ENGLAND
sections.text: NO CHANGES NEEDED FOR THIS SLIGHT RISK AREA.

sections.title: SRN AZ
sections.text: VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY INDICATED CU DEVELOPING OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF SERN AZ. THE 17Z HRRR SUGGESTS TSTMS WILL DEVELOP AND ADVANCE WWD ACROSS SERN TO SOUTH CENTRAL AZ LATE THIS AFTERNOON INTO THE EVENING...THOUGH CURRENT SLOW CU DEVELOPMENT DOES NOT WARRANT AN INCREASE IN SEVERE PROBABILITIES.

sections.title: PARTS OF NERN IND/NWRN OH/SERN LOWER MI AND NORTH CENTRAL PA
sections.text: GIVEN CONVECTIVE TRENDS/LIGHTNING DATA AND THE PRESENCE OF AT LEAST MARGINAL INSTABILITY...THE GENERAL TSTM AREA HAS BEEN EXPANDED INTO MORE OF NERN IND/NWRN OH TO SERN LOWER MI...AND A SEPARATE NWWD EXTENSION OF THE 10 PERCENT THUNDERSTORM LINE ACROSS NORTH CENTRAL PA.

sections.title: ELSEWHERE
sections.text: NO CHANGES WERE MADE TO THE PREVIOUS OUTLOOK. ..PETERS.. 08/15/2012 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1131 AM CDT WED AUG 15 2012/

WEAK HEIGHT FALLS/DCVA WITH A TROUGH NOW CROSSING THE CNTRL APPALACHIANS SHOULD AID IN SCATTERED TSTM DEVELOPMENT WHILE MODEST MID LEVEL FLOW ASSOCIATED WITH THE ADVANCING TROUGH RESULTS IN SUFFICIENT SHEAR FOR ORGANIZED STORMS IN THE FORM OF LINE SEGMENTS AND PERHAPS A SUPERCELL OR TWO. mesoscale_discussions.summary: SOME UNCERTAINTIES REMAIN...BUT TRENDS ARE BEING MONITORED FOR THE POSSIBILITY OF AN INCREASING SEVERE WEATHER THREAT /MAINLY STRONG THUNDERSTORM WIND GUSTS/ WHICH COULD REQUIRE A WATCH WITHIN THE NEXT HOUR OR TWO.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A SHORT WAVE TROUGH CONTINUES TO SLOWLY SHIFT ACROSS THE CENTRAL AND SOUTHERN APPALACHIANS REGION...WITH AT LEAST A COUPLE OF AREAS OF STRONGER FORCING FOR UPWARD VERTICAL MOTION. ONE APPEARS TO BE SPREADING EAST NORTHEASTWARD THROUGH PARTS OF SOUTHWESTERN VIRGINIA...GENERALLY NORTH OF A SLOW MOVING FRONTAL BOUNDARY EXTENDING ACROSS SOUTHEASTERN VIRGINIA THROUGH THE PIEDMONT OF THE CAROLINAS. ANOTHER AREA APPEARS LIKELY TO DEVELOP EAST SOUTHEAST OF THE SOUTHERN APPALACHIANS BETWEEN NOW AND 20-22Z. LATTER FORCING APPEARS TO BE CONTRIBUTING TO POST-FRONTAL STORMS ACROSS EASTERN TENNESSEE INTO WESTERN NORTH CAROLINA...AND...PERHAPS...NEW THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT ALONG THE FRONT TO THE WEST OF FAYETTEVILLE. FRONTAL CONVERGENCE CURRENTLY APPEARS FAIRLY WEAK...BUT THE BOUNDARY APPEARS TO PROVIDE A POTENTIAL FOCUS FOR INCREASING CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT AS THE UPPER IMPULSE PROGRESSES EAST OF THE SOUTHERN APPALACHIANS THIS AFTERNOON. A WESTERLY BELT OF 30-40 KT 500 MB FLOW OVERSPREADING THE PIEDMONT AND COASTAL PLAIN IS CONTRIBUTING TO MORE THAN SUFFICIENT SHEAR TO SUPPORT THE POTENTIAL EVOLUTION OF AN ORGANIZED MESOSCALE CONVECTIVE SYSTEM CAPABLE OF PRODUCING DAMAGING SURFACE GUSTS. THERMODYNAMIC PROFILES TO SUPPORT THIS POTENTIAL ARE A BIT MORE UNCERTAIN... BUT MID-LEVEL DRYING COULD ENHANCE EVAPORATIVE COOLING IN DOWNDRAFTS...AND LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES CONTINUE TO GRADUALLY STEEPEN AS SURFACE TEMPERATURES APPROACH OR EXCEED 90F.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ADDITIONAL THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT IS EXPECTED BY 21Z. SEMI-DISCRETE CELLS ARE EXPECTED TO TRANSITION INTO LINEAR SEGMENTS ALONG COLD FRONT. LARGE HAIL MAY INITIALLY BE POSSIBLE IN ADDITION TO DAMAGING WIND THREAT. WW WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED IN THE NEXT HOUR OR SO.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AN EASTWARD ADVANCING COLD FRONT WAS LOCATED FROM FAR NW MN INTO ERN SD AS OF 1930Z. TEMPERATURES HAVE WARMED INTO THE MID 70S TO LOW 80S AHEAD OF THE FRONT WITH DEWPOINTS INCREASING INTO THE LOW TO MID 60S. AS SUCH...ENVIRONMENT HAS BECOME MODERATELY UNSTABLE AND UNCAPPED. CONVECTION HAS BEEN SLOW TO DEVELOP IN THE VICINITY OF THE FRONT AND THIS IS LIKELY DUE TO LOW TO MIDLEVEL CLOUD COVER THAT DEVELOPED ACROSS CENTRAL MN THIS MORNING. HI-RES WRF-NMM...NSSL WRF AND HRRR ALL INDICATE CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT BY AROUND 20-21Z HOWEVER. LATEST RADAR DATA ALSO SEEMS TO BE INDICATING A SLOW UPWARD TREND WITH STRONGER CORES DEVELOPING FROM NEAR BELTRAMI TO MAHNOMEN COUNTY IN NW MN. SO...WHILE CONVECTIVE INITIATION HAS LIKELY BEEN DELAYED DUE TO THE AFOREMENTIONED CLOUD COVER...STORMS ARE STILL EXPECTED BY 21Z. STRONG DEEP LAYER SHEAR OF AROUND 30-50 KT WILL AID IN ORGANIZATION OF CELLS...WHICH MAY REMAIN SEMI-DISCRETE INITIALLY...INTO LINEAR SEGMENTS ALONG THE FRONT. STEEPENING LAPSE RATES AND STRONG MIDLEVEL FLOW WILL RESULT IN DAMAGING WIND THREAT...ESPECIALLY ONCE LINEAR ORGANIZATION OCCURS. OTHERWISE...STRONGER CELLS MAY INITIALLY ALSO POSE A LARGE HAIL THREAT. A WW WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED IN THE NEXT HOUR OR SO. THERE MAY BE THE NEED FOR TWO SEPARATE WATCHES WHERE CONVECTION FURTHER SOUTH ACROSS FAR ERN SD INTO NW IA/SW MN MAY BE SLOWER TO DEVELOP THAN THAT ACROSS NORTHERN AND CENTRAL MN.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A CONSOLIDATING CLUSTER OR LINE OF STORMS IS EXPECTED TO SPREAD ACROSS NORTH CAROLINA COASTAL AREAS...INCLUDING THE OUTER BANKS... DURING THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: INCREASING BOUNDARY LAYER CONVERGENCE ALONG THE AXIS OF STRONGEST PRE-FRONTAL HEATING ACROSS THE NORTH CAROLINA COASTAL PLAIN NOW APPEARS TO BE CONTRIBUTING TO AN EVOLVING LINE OF STORMS. IN THE PRESENCE OF HIGH MOISTURE CONTENT AND STRONG DEEP LAYER SHEAR ASSOCIATED WITH AN EASTWARD ADVANCING BELT OF 30-40 KT WEST SOUTHWESTERLY 500 MB FLOW...FURTHER CONVECTIVE GROWTH/EXPANSION AND ORGANIZATION APPEARS POSSIBLE ACROSS COASTAL AREAS AND THE OUTER BANKS THROUGH 22-23Z. THIS LIKELY WILL BE ACCOMPANIED BY FREQUENT CLOUD TO GROUND LIGHTNING...HEAVY RAINFALL AND THE POTENTIAL FOR ONE OR TWO DOWNBURSTS WITH POTENTIALLY DAMAGING SURFACE GUSTS. ..KERR.. 08/15/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SVR WIND GUSTS AND PERHAPS LOCALLY SVR HAIL WILL REMAIN OF CONCERN ACROSS THE WW AREA THROUGH THE EVENING...AS A SQUALL LINE CONTINUES TO EVOLVE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A SQUALL LINE EXTENDING FROM N-CNTRL MN SSWWD INTO W-CNTRL MN IS ADVANCING EWD AROUND 25-30 KT NEAR AND AHEAD OF A COLD FRONT. AREA RADAR IMAGERY SUGGESTS THAT THE LINE ONLY EXHIBITS MODEST ORGANIZATION ACROSS MN. WHILE AN EML PLUME FEATURING MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES OF 7-7.5 C/KM HAS BEEN DRAWN INTO THE REGION IN ADVANCE OF THE FRONT...INHIBITION ASSOCIATED WITH THIS PLUME HAS BEEN SLOW TO ERODE IN MANY AREAS OWING TO LIMITED LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES IN CONJUNCTION WITH THE STRATOCUMULUS FIELD MAINTAINED THROUGH THE DAY. AND...WITHOUT STRONGER FORCING FOR ASCENT AHEAD OF THE SQUALL LINE...CONVECTION WILL LIKELY REMAIN SPATIALLY CONFINED TO /1/ THE LEADING EDGE OF THE EVOLVING COLD POOL ATTENDANT TO THE SQUALL LINE AND /2/ SEGMENTS OF THE FRONT WHERE OVERTURNING HAS BEEN LIMITED. REGARDLESS...35 TO 45 KT OF EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR WILL LIKELY MAINTAIN A THREAT FOR SVR WIND GUSTS WITH THE SQUALL LINE...AND PARTICULARLY WITH ANY EMBEDDED BOWING SEGMENTS. ALSO OF NOTE...ACROSS S-CNTRL MN...GREATER COVERAGE OF INSOLATION PER VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGES IS BOOSTING INSTABILITY. AS SUCH...MORE ROBUST EMBEDDED CONVECTIVE STRUCTURES...PERHAPS EXHIBITING SEMI-DISCRETE CHARACTERISTICS IN INCIPIENT STAGES...WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE INVOF THE SRN EXTENT OF THE LINE. BOTH SVR HAIL AND SVR WIND GUSTS WILL BE OF CONCERN WITH THIS ACTIVITY. HOWEVER...IN THIS AREA...THE LAGGING NATURE OF THE LOBE OF ASCENT ACCOMPANYING AN APPROACHING SHORTWAVE TROUGH...AND LACK OF MORE SRN INFLUENCE TO THE SQUALL-LINE-ACCOMPANYING COLD POOL...MAY LIMIT THE COVERAGE OF CONVECTION ACROSS SRN AREAS OF THE WW. THE SVR THREAT WILL RAPIDLY WANE FOLLOWING FRONTAL PASSAGE. ..COHEN.. 08/15/2012

mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A FEW WEAKENING CONVECTIVE CLUSTERS EMBEDDED WITHIN...AND RESIDING ON THE BACK EDGE OF...A REMNANT STRATIFORM REGION CONTINUE PROGRESSING EWD/SEWD ACROSS THE WW AREA. AS SUCH...ASSOCIATED CONVECTION WILL LIKELY STRUGGLE TO MAINTAIN ONGOING WEAK/MODERATE INTENSITY...AND THE SVR THREAT HAS LARGELY CEASED. MODERATE STEERING-LAYER FLOW SHOULD TAKE A RISK FOR SUB-SEVERE STORMS EAST OF REMAINING VALID PORTIONS OF THE WW AREA WITHIN THE NEXT FEW HOURS. HOWEVER...WEAK INSTABILITY WILL PRECLUDE WW ISSUANCE DOWNSTREAM. ..COHEN.. 08/16/2012
